wargear.name: Sub-dermal plating
wargear.summary: Armour sheets implanted beneath the skin of a conclave's best.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Sub-dermal plating has a Save Characteristic of 3+, unless its Save Characteristic is already better.

wargear.name: Refractor halo
wargear.summary: A ring of old-pattern deflector crystals worn around the Marshal's head.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Refractor halo has an Invulnerable Save of 4+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Cantor choir
wargear.summary: Vox-casters and chanting augmetic cantors broadcast the conclave's war-cant.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Cantor choir, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Leadership and Cool Characteristics.

wargear.name: Stim-pump
wargear.summary: A reactor-fed injector spikes the pilgrym's pulse for the charge.
wargear.text: In any Battle Turn in which a Unit equipped with Stim-pumps makes a Charge, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Attacks Characteristic until the end of the Assault Phase.

wargear.name: Cant-coda
wargear.summary: A firing script uploaded from the conclave's gunnery cant.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Cant-coda, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Ballistic Skill Characteristic.

wargear.name: Cradle of servo-arms
wargear.summary: A sling of servo-arms and spare plate carried inside the hull.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Cradle of servo-arms adds 1 to its Hull Points Characteristic.

wargear.name: Waste-hide cloak
wargear.summary: A cloak of sand-coloured hide dyed with ash and dust.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Waste-hide cloak has the Shrouded (5+) and Waste Cloak Special Rules.

wargear.name: Rousing-cant standard
wargear.summary: A rattling standard whose bells chime the conclave's war-cant.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Rousing-cant standard, all Models in that Unit have the Rousing Cant Special Rule.

wargear.name: Dead-drop beacon
wargear.summary: A pulsing locator the Marshal plants for those still to arrive.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Dead-drop beacon has the Dead-Drop Special Rule.

wargear.name: Rad-nimbus furnace
wargear.summary: A back-mounted reactor that bathes the bearer in killing glare.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Rad-nimbus furnace has the Rad-Nimbus Special Rule.

wargear.name: Geiger-vane mast
wargear.summary: A spinning sensor mast that tastes the contamination in the air.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Geiger-vane mast has the Hot-Zone Sensing Special Rule.

wargear.name: Ablative sand-skirts
wargear.summary: Sacrificial skirts of plate that crumble under fire.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Ablative sand-skirts adds 1 to its Side Armour Value and has the Shed Plating Special Rule.

wargear.name: Kill-code scroll
wargear.summary: A strip of scored data-vellum that overrides every restraint in an automaton's core.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Kill-code scroll, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Weapon Skill Characteristic, subtract 1 from their Ballistic Skill Characteristic and have the Kill-Code Special Rule.

modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

rules.name: Rad-Saturation
rules.summary: The Corpus walks ahead of the line, fouling the ground.
rules.text: All enemy Models within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule subtract 1 from their Cool and Leadership Characteristics. This negative modifier is removed as soon as no Model in the enemy Unit is within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule.

rules.name: Long Watch
rules.text: A Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule that did not move in its last Movement Phase gives every Ranged Weapon its Models use in a Shooting Attack the Precision (6+) Special Rule for that attack; a Weapon that already has a Precision (X) Special Rule uses the lower value of X. When the Controlling Player deploys, a Unit with this Special Rule is placed after all other Units on that Player's side have been deployed.

rules.name: Run Them Down
rules.summary: The hounds close on a wounded foe.
rules.text: Add 2 to the result of any Charge Roll made for a Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule.

rules.name: War-Cant Chorus
rules.text: While a Model with this Special Rule is within 6" of another friendly Model with this Special Rule, it adds 1 to its Ballistic Skill Characteristic.

rules.name: Ten Thousand Dead
rules.summary: The chaff is counted in tens of thousands and no one counts the losses.
rules.text: While a Unit with this Special Rule includes five or more Models, it automatically passes any Panic Check and any Cool Check it is required to make, including those made for Pinning.

rules.name: Waste Cloak
rules.summary: Sand-coloured hide dyed with ash and dust makes the wearer part of the wasteland.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Infiltrate (9) Special Rule when it is deployed wholly within a Wasteland or Ruin terrain feature.

rules.name: Rousing Cant
rules.summary: The bells chime and the conclave surges forward.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule automatically passes any Cool Check made for Pinning, and adds 1 to the result of any Charge Roll it makes.

rules.name: Dead-Drop
rules.summary: A pulsing locator planted for those still to arrive.
rules.text: A friendly Unit that arrives from Reserves and is set up wholly within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule does not Scatter.

rules.name: Rad-Nimbus
rules.summary: A back-mounted reactor bathes the bearer in killing glare.
rules.text: While an enemy Model is Locked in Combat with a Model with this Special Rule, it subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic.

rules.name: Hot-Zone Sensing
rules.summary: A spinning sensor mast that tastes the contamination in the air.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule does not make Dangerous Terrain Tests, and adds 1 to the result of its Hit Tests against Units that have suffered the effects of the Phage (X) Special Rule.

rules.name: Shed Plating
rules.summary: Sacrificial skirts of plate crumble under the first blow.
rules.text: The first Glancing Hit allocated to a Model with this Special Rule in each battle is discarded.

rules.name: Kill-Code
rules.summary: A strip of scored data-vellum overrides every restraint in an automaton's core.
rules.text: Whenever a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule is able to declare a Charge, it must declare a Charge against the nearest enemy Unit it can reach.

rites.name: The Vanguard Saturation Cant
rites.flavor: The Vanguard walk ahead of the line, and the ground behind them stays too hot to retake.

modifiers.text: The Vanguard Saturation Cant: Infiltrate (9), Rad-Saturation.

require.note: Bring at least two Battle-Pilgrym Corpuses.

rites.text: The Vanguard walk ahead of the line, and the ground behind them stays too hot to retake.
benefits: They gain Rad-Saturation: enemy Units within 6" of a Corpus subtract 1 from their Cool and Leadership Characteristics.
limitations: At least two Battle-Pilgrym Corpuses are required.
No Armour, Heavy Transport, War Engine or Heavy Assault units.

rites.name: The Ranger Long Watch
rites.flavor: Patience is a weapon. The Rangers have a great deal of it.

modifiers.text: The Ranger Long Watch: Long Watch.

require.note: Bring at least one Battle-Pilgrym Corpus.

rites.text: Patience is a weapon. The Rangers have a great deal of it.
benefits: Battle-Pilgrym Corpuses and the Battle-Pilgrym Marshal gain Long Watch: if they did not move in their last Movement Phase, every Ranged Weapon they use in a Shooting Attack has Precision (6+).
Units with Long Watch are deployed after all other Units on their side.
limitations: At least one Battle-Pilgrym Marshal and one Battle-Pilgrym Corpus are required.
No Vorax or Vultarax automata, no Destructor Castellax Maniples and no Domitar.

rites.name: The Sicarian Hunt
rites.flavor: The conclave unleashes its fast-killing hounds and does not look back.

modifiers.text: The Sicarian Hunt: Outflank, Run Them Down.
The Sicarian Hunt: Fast (1), Outflank, Run Them Down.

require.note: Bring at least two hunting automata.

rites.text: The conclave unleashes its fast-killing hounds and does not look back.
benefits: Vorax Attack Maniples and Vultarax Stratos Automata may fill Troops slots and gain Outflank. Vultarax also gain Fast (1); Vorax already have Fast (2).
They gain Run Them Down: +2 to Charge Rolls.
limitations: At least two Vorax or Vultarax units are required.
No more than one Battle-Pilgrym Corpus.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or War Engine units.

rites.name: The Armoured War-Cant
rites.flavor: Karacnos tracks, Krios lances: the conclave rides its own chorus into battle.

modifiers.text: The Armoured War-Cant: Line (1), War-Cant Chorus.

modifiers.condition: while within 6" of another friendly War-Cant Chorus unit

rites.text: Karacnos tracks, Krios lances: the conclave rides its own chorus into battle.
benefits: Karacnos, Krios and Krios Venator tanks may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain War-Cant Chorus: +1 Ballistic Skill while within 6" of another War-Cant Chorus tank.
limitations: At least three of those tanks are required.
No more than one Battle-Pilgrym Corpus and no Bonepicker Hosts.

rites.name: The Bonepicker Tithe
rites.flavor: The conclave's dead are counted in thousands, and its chaff is counted in tens of thousands.

modifiers.text: The Bonepicker Tithe: Line (1), Outflank, Ten Thousand Dead.

require.note: Bring at least two Bonepicker Hosts.

rites.text: The conclave's dead are counted in thousands, and its chaff is counted in tens of thousands.
benefits: Bonepicker Hosts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1) and Outflank.
They gain Ten Thousand Dead: while at five or more Models they automatically pass Panic Checks and Cool Checks, including those made for Pinning.
limitations: At least two Bonepicker Hosts are required.
No more than one Battle-Pilgrym Corpus.
No Elites, Heavy Assault or Lord of War units.

armyRules.name: Rad-Hardened
armyRules.flavor: Generations in the irradiated wastes have left the Skitarii immune to their own poisons.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule is not affected by the Phage (X) or Poisoned (X) Special Rules of Weapons with the Rad Trait, friend or foe.
Models in a Unit with this Special Rule may make a Feel No Pain (5+) Damage Mitigation Test against Wounds inflicted by Weapons with the Rad Trait.
drawbacks: All Models with this Special Rule subtract 1 from their Leadership Characteristic.

armyRules.name: Prey-Cant
armyRules.flavor: The hunt is run by cant, and it admits no second quarry.
benefits: At the start of the Shooting Phase the Controlling Player names one enemy Unit as the Prey. Models with this Special Rule add 1 to the result of their Hit Tests against the Prey.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule must direct at least one of its Weapons at the Prey in each Shooting Attack it makes, if able.

armyRules.name: Overseer's Cant
armyRules.flavor: The Marshal's voice holds the pack together.
benefits: While a Unit with this Special Rule is within 12" of a friendly Battle-Pilgrym Marshal, all Models in it add 1 to their Cool Characteristic.
drawbacks: If the Battle-Pilgrym Marshal is removed as a casualty, all Models in Units with this Special Rule subtract 1 from their Cool Characteristic for the rest of the battle.
